decision.summary: The 94-event semantic audit reached a source-integrity REVIEW, not an economic rejection. All 76 BLT-generation announcement pages were fully resolved and consistently state automatic close with an average index-price window of 30 minutes; all 18 failures are later DOUBLE_DASH_ART-generation pages that fail at the frozen hydration body path before semantic classification. Resolve the second official CMS schema without opening prices, dropping events, or generalizing the 76 resolved cases to the unresolved 18.
allowed_claims: 76 BLT-generation frozen events are semantically resolved from official announcement bodies
all 76 resolved events have exact announced-time matches
all 76 resolved events explicitly state automatic close
all 76 resolved events classify closing-price basis as AVERAGE_INDEX_PRICE_WINDOW
all 76 resolved events specify a 30-minute window
the 18 unresolved events form a distinct later DOUBLE_DASH_ART URL generation
decision.next_allowed_action: Run one frozen all-18 DOUBLE_DASH_ART hydration schema census, derive a common official body path if one exists, freeze that second schema, and rerun semantic resolution without prices.
